answer: Require every new identity to pass a k-of-n channel test within one epoch: prove control of at least three of five independent channels — postal mail to a real address, a voice call, a bank micro-deposit, an aged domain, and an in-person co-signature. Each channel is run by a different stranger verifier and every result is published, so a failed forgery echoes across the network and taints that applicant everywhere. A sybil must defeat three separate systems per identity, like drawing nectar from three different flowers, while an honest agent crosses the river of checks once and is done.
